svg.title: Two cross-sections of the wafer, one above the other. Before the step a dotted glass with a flat top buries the active areas, the oxide-filled trench with a wide stack on it and a narrow capped gate. After it a thin flat oxide of even thickness covers the whole glass.
svg.desc: Two cross-sections of the wafer, one above the other. Before the step a dotted glass with a flat top buries the active areas, the oxide-filled trench with a wide stack on it and a narrow capped gate. After it a thin flat oxide of even thickness covers the whole glass.
svg.text: An undoped oxide is deposited over the polished glass.
After: a cap oxide seals the glass
Not to scale. Thin films are drawn thicker than they are.
